BUG: the blind-player run never saves the narrator prompts, so nobody can read the recorded prompt of a failing turn. The staging server returns `payload.prompt` as an OBJECT `{ "system": <string>, "user": <string> }` (storygame/runtime/cloudflare.py sets `last_prompt = {"system": ..., "user": ...}`). turnRecord in blind-player.js copies it into `turn.prompt` correctly. But playScene in blind-player.spec.js builds `prompts` with `typeof turn.prompt === "string" && turn.prompt.trim()`, which is false for an object, so `prompts` is always []. The existing test in blind-player.test.js used a string prompt ("full prompt"), which is why nothing caught it.

FIX:
1. In blind-player.js add and export a pure function `collectPrompts(turns)` returning `[{ turn, prompt }]` for every turn whose `prompt` is an object with a non-blank string `system` and a non-blank string `user` (keep the object as is). A non-blank string prompt is also accepted unchanged (older shape). null, undefined, blank strings, objects missing either field, and arrays are skipped.
2. In playScene (blind-player.spec.js) use `collectPrompts(turns)` for the run's `prompts` field.
3. Prompts are large (several KB each, about 120 turns per replicate in all-scenes mode), so they must NOT go into the main report. In the spec, after the run records are built, write them to a SEPARATE file with writeCategoryReport using category `blind-player-prompts` with the replicate suffix of the existing category: when `category` is `blind-player-r<N>` the prompts category is `blind-player-prompts-r<N>`, and when it is `blind-player` it is `blind-player-prompts`. Factor that name into a small exported pure function `promptsCategory(category)` in blind-player.js. The file content is `{ story_id, scene, replicates: [{ replicate, scenes: [{ scene, prompts }] }] }` for all mode, and for single-scene mode the same shape with one entry in `scenes`. Then remove `prompts` from every run record before the main report is written, so the main JSON no longer carries an empty or large `prompts` field. The main report must keep every other field exactly as it is (turns, semantic_matches, exit_cause and so on).
4. In scripts/ringer/affordance/scene-affordance-l2-all-live.sh the line that removes old artifacts must also remove `../artifacts/e2e-blind-player-prompts*.json` and `../artifacts/e2e-blind-player-prompts*.md`. The existing `cp ../artifacts/e2e-blind-player*.json` already copies the prompts files; do not change that. The script must pass `bash -n`.

TESTS (no live model), in blind-player.test.js: collectPrompts keeps an object prompt unchanged with its turn number; keeps a non-blank string; skips null, blank string, object with only `system`, and an array; promptsCategory maps `blind-player-r2` to `blind-player-prompts-r2` and `blind-player` to `blind-player-prompts`. Leave the existing tests passing; do not weaken them.

HOW TO RUN (from worktree root): `cd frontend && ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules node_modules 2>/dev/null; node --test e2e/*.test.js`; `cd frontend && E2E_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9 npx playwright test --list --grep @blind-player`.
